title: Amazon launches Alexa+ in India with Hindi support | TechCrunch
summary: The company said that the new Alexa has a more expressive voice and can handle complex multi-step tasks, including ordering groceries from Amazon’s quick commerce service Amazon Now and turning on/off smart home devices.
